headline: Federal Court Orders Guarujá Triplex Auction Proceeds To OAS Group
seoTitle: Court Awards Guarujá Triplex Funds to OAS
metaDescription: A Brasília federal court has ordered that over R$ 2.4 million from the 2018 auction of the Guarujá triplex be transferred to the OAS construction group.
aiSummaryBullets: The Federal Court of Brasília ruled that proceeds from the 2018 auction of a Guarujá property must be released to the OAS group.
The funds, currently held in a judicial account at Caixa Econômica Federal, total more than R$ 2.42 million including monetary corrections.
The property was previously linked to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva during the Lava Jato corruption investigations.
aiContextParagraph: The legal dispute involves a luxury apartment located in the coastal city of Guarujá, São Paulo. The property became a focal point of the Lava Jato investigations, during which it was attributed to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The unit was eventually sold in a 2018 judicial auction. Following that sale, the generated capital was placed into a judicial account managed by the state-run Caixa Econômica Federal. According to the recent court order issued by the Federal Court of Brasília on Monday, November 9, 2026, these accumulated funds, which have grown to over R$ 2.42 million due to interest and monetary adjustments, are now to be transferred to the OAS group. This decision marks a new development regarding the assets tied to the historic corruption probes that involved the construction firm and various political figures in Brazil.
whyItIsViral: The story is gaining traction due to persistent public search interest surrounding the high-profile Lava Jato corruption investigations.
